faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Unraveling the 2012 murder of college student Faith Hedgepeth and the breakthrough.
kurzfassung: Fourteen years after 19-year-old college student Faith Hedgepeth was found murdered in her apartment, advanced genetic genealogy finally led investigators to her killer. Despite extensive DNA evidence and a trial involving disputed third-party theories, a jury convicted Miguel Salguero Olivares of first-degree murder. The verdict brought a measure of closure and long-awaited justice to Faith's grieving family and community.
stichpunkte: Faith Hedgepeth was found beaten to death in her Chapel Hill off-campus apartment in September 2012.
Investigators recovered male DNA from the crime scene, including on a rum bottle used as the murder weapon.
Police tested over 1,800 people and checked several persons of interest, but all initial DNA comparisons were dead ends.
A mysterious handwritten note left on a paper bag at the scene featured male DNA and the phrase 'I'm not stupid bitch jealous.'
Genetic genealogists CeCe Moore and Carol used family trees pointing to Guatemala to zero in on a suspect living in North Carolina.
Surveillance and covertly collected DNA matched Miguel Salguero Olivares to the crime scene profile, leading to his 2021 arrest.
The defense attempted to shift suspicion toward roommate Karina Rosario, but the judge barred third-party culpability arguments.
A Durham County jury found Miguel Salguero Olivares guilty of first-degree murder, rape, and burglary, resulting in a sentence of life without parole.

clips.hook: Four years with no arrests until a huge development breathes new life.
clips.text: Years pass with no suspects or answers until revolutionary DNA phenotyping technology offers a potential glimpse at the killer's face.

beschreibung:
A college student is murdered in her off-campus apartment. Thousands of potential suspects, hundreds of DNA samples and painstaking work over a decade finally lead to a verdict.
